children: Singapore Airlines said on Facebook that it canceled all flights to and from Jakarta on September 7, as well as one flight on September 8, because of the eruption of Indonesia's Anak Krakatau volcano. According to Sina Finance, the airline said other flights between Singapore and Indonesia may also be affected as the situation remains fluid.

title: Singapore Airlines Cancels All Jakarta Flights on September 7 After Indonesian Volcano Eruption
